end.summary:
Anika identified using dustbins and picking up wrappers as ways to keep school clean.
Anika explained that keeping the school clean is a shared responsibility, not only the cleaning staff’s job.
Anika recalled that microbes need air in a compost pit.
Anika repeatedly mixed up compostable waste with plastic and foil; they later recognised that foil and plastic do not rot and can remain in the pit.
Anika identified the blue bin for dry waste.
end.parentNote: Anika practised ways everyone can help keep school clean, green and safe, including using dustbins and picking up wrappers after lunch. Anika used the idea that microbes need air in a compost pit and explained why the cleaning staff cannot do all the work alone. Anika initially said plastic and foil could turn into soil, but later corrected this by noticing that they would remain in the pit and could harm plants. At home, ask Anika to sort a few household items into wet/green-bin and dry/blue-bin waste and explain each choice.
